title: October 20, 1962: a border conflict began that would reshape how India builds its defenses for the next six decades.

sources.text: Naval War College Review - The Sino-Indian Border War

caption:
October 20, 1962: a border conflict began that would reshape how India builds its defenses for the next six decades.

The conflict exposed gaps in India's border infrastructure, high-altitude logistics and military preparedness - lessons that shaped defense policy for generations afterward.

The Border Roads Organisation's mandate expanded, defense R&D investment grew and the push toward domestic weapons manufacturing that India still pursues today traces directly back to the gaps this conflict exposed.

The decades of investment in border roads, high-altitude logistics and domestic defense manufacturing that followed 1962 are the direct ancestors of the self-reliant defense sector India is still building today.
